title: Enhanced Due Diligence for Politically Exposed Persons

paragraphs.text: Reference is invited to circular GZ-KYC-2019-02 dated August 20, 2019 under which Politically Exposed Persons are classified as high-risk customers. This circular prescribes the enhanced due diligence measures that banks shall apply when establishing or continuing a relationship with Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs).

Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) shall mean individuals who are or have been entrusted with prominent public functions by a foreign country, including Heads of State or Government, senior politicians, senior government, judicial or military officers, senior executives of state-owned corporations and important political party officials.

Senior management approval for PEPs: the decision to open an account for a Politically Exposed Person shall be taken by senior management, being an official not below the rank of General Manager, and the approval shall be recorded before the account is opened.

Source of funds for PEPs: the bank shall take reasonable measures to establish the source of funds and the source of wealth of a Politically Exposed Person, and shall obtain supporting documents such as income tax returns or declarations of assets.

Enhanced monitoring for PEPs: accounts of Politically Exposed Persons shall be subjected to enhanced ongoing monitoring, including a review of all transactions at least once every quarter by the compliance function, and the KYC profile of every PEP shall be reviewed at least annually.

Existing customer becoming a PEP: where an existing customer or the beneficial owner of an existing account becomes a Politically Exposed Person, senior management approval shall be obtained within 30 days to continue the relationship. The PEP measures of circular GZ-AML-2020-02 also apply to family members and close associates of PEPs and are effective from November 1, 2020.
